title: Easy Faucet
tagline: A Dapp to make it easy to receive blockchain faucets while preventing spam attack on faucets
description:
Obtaining faucet from the testnet should not be difficult. Faucets get drained due to spam attacks resulting from the lack of checks. This dApp helps users acquire faucet from various networks and prevents spam attacks on faucets.
 
How it works:
- Users can mint a Faucet NFT from the mainnet to gain access to the faucet
- Users can also verify their uniqueness and real identity using Worldcoin to gain access to the faucet

Contacts:
Mode Testnet => 0xc1c025BC0A13Aba567f6C85Ea2A642AFb3d6bEd6
how_its_made:
I developed the dApp using React and styled it with Chakra UI. The contract was built using Hardhat, while the server was constructed using Node.js and Express.js. I deployed my contracts on the Mode Testnet for Faucet NFT.

I used the following technologies:
- Mode - I deployed the contract on Mode Testnet for cheap gas fee
- Worldcoin - I use Anonymous Actions to ensure that users can claim the faucet only once.. I used Cloud Verification on the backend.
